audience: field service companies that dispatch technicians with Synchroteam

useCases.title: See scheduled jobs and who does them
useCases.text: The AI lists jobs filtered by status, schedule window, technician, team, customer or site, and reads one job with its times, parts used and report.

useCases.title: Look up a customer with their sites and equipment
useCases.text: The AI finds a customer by name or email, then lists their sites and the pieces of equipment at those sites.

useCases.title: Check parts stock in depots and vans
useCases.text: The AI lists stock depots (warehouses and technician vans), reads the quantity of each part in one depot, and lists the parts catalog and technicians' part requests.

useCases.title: Review invoices and quotations
useCases.text: The AI lists invoices and quotations with number, status, customer, job and totals, and reads one with its lines.

useCases.title: Create, schedule, start or complete a job
useCases.text: The AI creates a job for a customer, schedules it for a technician between two times, marks it as started and completes it. Synchroteam may send notifications as set in your account.

useCases.title: Create customers, sites or equipment, or update a customer
useCases.text: The AI creates a customer with an address, creates a site for a customer, adds equipment under a site or customer, and updates fields of an existing customer.
